body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched existing issues and this hasn't been reported yet. Related but different: #8126 and #1920 (missing `result` in stream-json, closed), #38673 (empty result when `overageStatus` is `rejected`), #49640 (`rate_limit_event` injected mid-line), #98170 (print-mode wind-down of background tasks).
- [x] This is a single bug report (the `ANTHROPIC_LOG` stdout problem below is closely related; happy to split it out)
- [x] Seen with Claude Code 2.1.303; the reproduction below uses 2.1.304

### What's Wrong?

A long `claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose` session (subscription auth, model `opus`, `ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug`) hit the 7-day limit and **exited with code 1 without reporting the limit on stdout**:

- no `rate_limit_event` with `status: "rejected"` (the last one was `allowed_warning`, utilization 0.97, written before the failing request);
- no synthetic assistant message with `error: "rate_limit"` / "You've hit your weekly limit · resets 11am (UTC)";
- no `result` event (`api_error: "usage_limit_reached"`).

The message existed only in the session transcript (`~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<session>.jsonl`, an `assistant` entry with `isApiErrorMessage: true`). The last stdout line was a base64 fragment from the `ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug` request dump. A host that reads stdout (we run [Hive Mind](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind)) saw only "exit code 1", so the run was reported as a crash and was not resumed when the window reset.

Before the exit the process stalled. After an automatic compaction it wrote nothing to stdout for 23.5 minutes, then logged a 404 whose server `date` was 18:51:37 with `durationMs: 1432110`. Claude Code measures that duration itself, so the response was handled about 24 minutes after it arrived. The host process was idle during that time.

| Host log time (UTC) | stdout content                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 18:51:17            | `compact_boundary` (auto)                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| 18:51:36            | `[log_3d9a7c] sending request`                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| 18:51:37 → 19:15:11 | nothing (23.5 min)                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| 19:15:11 – 19:17:19 | events 25–38 min old (assistant message created 18:38:46, a 200 with `date` 18:39:23)                                                                                                                                                       |
| 19:19:47            | `[log_3d9a7c] response error (error; not retryable)` `status: 404`, `date: 18:51:37`, `durationMs: 1432110`                                                                                                                                 |
| 19:27:58            | last `rate_limit_event`: `allowed_warning`, `seven_day`, `utilization 0.97`, `resetsAt 1792494000`; `task_updated` for a background task that ended at 18:51:19                                                                             |
| 19:30:12            | `[log_be123b] response error (error; no more retries left)` `status: 429`, `date: 19:18:37`, `anthropic-ratelimit-unified-7d-status: rejected`, `anthropic-ratelimit-unified-reset: 1792494000`, `retry-after: 56482`, then one base64 line |
| 19:30:12            | process exits 1. No `rate_limit_event` rejected, no assistant error message, no `result`.                                                                                                                                                   |

Transcript entry (19:19:48): `assistant isApiErrorMessage=true: "You've hit your weekly limit · resets 11am (UTC)"`.

A second, related problem: with `ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug`, the SDK's request/response dumps (multi-line JS object literals and raw base64 body fragments) go to **stdout**, interleaved with the stream-json events. The stream is no longer line-delimited JSON, and in this run that output made up most of the 26 MB log.

### What Should Happen?

1. Every print-mode exit after an API error should emit the same events as a normal usage-limit exit: the `rejected` `rate_limit_event` (with `resetsAt`), the synthetic assistant message and a `result` with `is_error: true`, `api_error: "usage_limit_reached"` and `terminal_reason: "api_error"`. If the transcript gets an `isApiErrorMessage` entry, stdout should get it too.
2. Flush stdout before exiting (wait for `process.stdout` to drain instead of calling `process.exit()` with writes pending).
3. Send `ANTHROPIC_LOG` output to stderr, or to the `--debug-file`, when `--output-format stream-json` is used, so stdout stays valid JSONL.
4. Look into why a 404 response was handled 24 minutes late after auto-compaction (event loop blocked?).

### Steps to Reproduce

The normal path works. With a mock API that answers every request with the 429 from this run, Claude Code 2.1.304 emits all three events and exits 1:

```bash
# Mock: https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-3570-e9ebcaf8355f/experiments/issue-3570/mock-weekly-limit-server.mjs
node mock-weekly-limit-server.mjs 8793 &
D=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$D/home/.claude" "$D/work"; cd "$D/work"
env -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY HOME="$D/home" CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR="$D/home/.claude" \
  CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=sk-ant-oat01-dummy ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8793 ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug \
  claude -p "say hi" --output-format stream-json --verbose --model opus > out.jsonl; echo "exit=$?"
grep '^{' out.jsonl | jq -c 'select(.subtype != "init") | {type, rate_limit_info, error, api_error, result, terminal_reason}'
grep -vc '^{' out.jsonl   # ANTHROPIC_LOG dump lines mixed into stdout
```

Output (2.1.304):

```
exit=1
{"type":"rate_limit_event","rate_limit_info":{"status":"rejected","resetsAt":1792494000,"rateLimitType":"seven_day","overageStatus":"rejected","overageDisabledReason":"org_level_disabled","isUsingOverage":false},…}
{"type":"assistant","error":"rate_limit","api_error":"usage_limit_reached",… "You've hit your weekly limit · resets 11am (UTC)"}
{"type":"result","api_error":"usage_limit_reached","result":"You've hit your weekly limit · resets 11am (UTC)","terminal_reason":"api_error",…}
```

The non-JSON debug lines (`[log_…] sending request {`, `method: "POST",` …) show up on stdout every time, so problem 2 reproduces directly. The other variants we tried also kept all three events: a background `sleep 120` task, several tool turns before the 429, and a reader that sleeps 30–60 s before draining 8 kB–300 kB of stdout. So losing the events seems to need the long-session state (auto-compaction, a 26.8 MB transcript, the stalled event loop). We could not recreate that with a mock. The real log is public: https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/tree/issue-3570-e9ebcaf8355f/docs/case-studies/issue-3570.

### Workaround

On a non-zero exit, Hive Mind now checks five sources and treats any one of them as enough: the `result` event or last line, the synthetic assistant message, the transcript tail (`isApiErrorMessage`), the last `rate_limit_event` (`rejected` with `resetsAt`) and the `ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug` 429 headers (`anthropic-ratelimit-unified-status: rejected` with `anthropic-ratelimit-unified-reset`). Debug lines are no longer used as the failure reason. See https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/pull/3571.

### Claude Code Version

2.1.303 (failing run), 2.1.304 (reproduction)

### Platform

Anthropic API (Claude subscription, OAuth)

### Operating System

Ubuntu/Debian Linux (Docker), Node v26
title: [BUG] Print mode exits 1 on a weekly usage limit without the rate_limit_event, error message or result on stdout (message only in the transcript)
